name: An "if" inside a quoted ability stays in the quote — Regal Sliver, Dementia Sliver
notes: The trailing-'if' stripper (Pattern D) took an 'if [condition]' out of a quoted ability granted to other permanents when the condition parsed, leaving ', ,' in the quote and putting the condition on the grant. It surfaced when 'you're the monarch' became a condition (Regal Sliver) and was already mangling Dementia Sliver, Tazri, Guild Artisan, Nadu and others. Player 2 is the monarch and their tab is open; Player 1 controls Regal Sliver and Dementia Sliver and fires Regal Sliver's granted enters trigger: Player 1 is not the monarch, so the Slivers get nothing (Regal Sliver 3/3, Dementia Sliver 3/3). Dementia Sliver's parsed grant keeps 'If that card has the chosen name' (checked on the effect: the granted ability does not show in a state's abilities, already so before this change). Memory: project_monarch_initiative_conditions_2026-10-14.

params.ability: {T}: Choose a card name. Target opponent reveals a card at random from their hand. If that card has the chosen name, that player discards it. Activate only during your turn.
